title: A wall becomes protection
summary: Construction becomes a resource the town depends on, then danger passes beyond the defenses.

steps.event: Pristinia’s wall is finished
steps.connection: The completed wall later has a material role in defense.

steps.event: The Delerium assault reaches Pristinia
steps.connection: The wall holds a blow, but the assault brings contamination into town.

steps.event: Acolyte tests Pristinia’s walls
steps.connection: Later defenses face a new quest; this is continuing civic history, not proof of one unchanged threat.

title: Making Gael live again
summary: Restoration grows from material planning into living ground and woodland, with continued work and later loss.

steps.event: Gartina and Saray plan to restore Gael’s soil
steps.connection: Research and material care precede the later forest.

steps.event: Adelia and Elenia help establish living ground in Gael
steps.connection: The early living foothold predates the later Hallowing and Adelia’s 2026 transformation; the work is communal.

steps.event: Nienna gives herself so Hope can live
steps.connection: The Hallowing carries a chosen personal cost.

steps.event: Gartina plants Stake and brings forth a forest
steps.connection: Shared material work and planting create a larger living landscape.

steps.event: Hope, Stake, and Shadowangel Forest are present
steps.connection: Later testimony records the restored places already present in 2025.

title: Knowledge that outlives Anky
summary: Loss leads to shared records and research; the recovered Wasteland narration supplies the expedition’s fatal encounter.

steps.event: Voraketh takes something from Anky
steps.connection: Knowledge loss gives protected memory practical urgency.

steps.event: Coralyn and Anky form an early Chain model
steps.connection: A working model guides questions without settling the island’s purpose.

steps.event: Anky commissions the Voraketh map
steps.connection: Knowledge becomes something later travelers can inherit.

steps.event: Anky’s final recovered expedition begins
steps.connection: The record follows his return to investigation.

steps.event: The chain-guard construct kills Anky and Alfred
steps.connection: The killing is explicitly narrated in the Wasteland, after the earlier retreat; the cause is no longer inferred from an afterlife scene.

steps.event: Cerwin falls after witnessing his companions’ deaths
steps.connection: A later narration records the third expedition member falling; posting intervals are not measured in-world duration.

steps.event: St. Anky walks the road to the afterlife
steps.connection: The Wasteland scene now identifies the fatal chain-guard encounter; his records survive their maker.

title: Papirak’s inheritance becomes a public responsibility
summary: Burial, a disputed possession and an unfinished institution require choices from the living.

steps.event: Pell prepares Papirak’s burial and memorial
steps.connection: Care for the body becomes preparation for a civic farewell.

steps.event: Pristinia opens a vote on Papirak’s Staff of Power
steps.connection: Value, ownership and public need produce different proposals.

steps.event: Papirak’s staff is entombed under Sequester
steps.connection: The disposition is completed; suspicion does not change the observed burial.

steps.event: Papirak’s mourners turn toward living
steps.connection: Restoration is promised, while food and fellowship return people to living.

title: From the Common Man to Pilgrim’s Hearth
summary: Destruction becomes shared rebuilding, then ordinary social life returns.

steps.event: Zombie pirates burn the Common Man
steps.connection: The fire leaves a visible ruin and a need for rebuilding.

steps.event: Pristinia clears the Common Man’s ruins
steps.connection: People salvage, carry and donate toward a replacement.

steps.event: Pristinia’s cedar is stolen in Eovar
steps.connection: The rebuilding project connects Pristinia to a dispute beyond town.

steps.event: The replacement tavern shows its new bones
steps.connection: Construction makes the proposed replacement physically visible before ordinary tavern life is attested.

steps.event: Pilgrim’s Hearth returns ordinary social life
steps.connection: Tea and conversation show what rebuilding has made possible.

title: A foothold creates responsibilities
summary: Custody of survivors and a seed leads to defense, an offensive and further rescues; each outcome leaves work to do.

steps.event: A Babel nomad entrusts Elenia with a golden seed
steps.connection: Rescue creates an obligation to keep people and the seed safe.

steps.event: Skylight Refuge holds through a divided defense
steps.connection: Holding the shelter saves civilians while leaving companions wounded or lost.

steps.event: Babel’s defenders reshape the cavern-bearing mountain
steps.connection: The offensive changes the stronghold without confirming every consequence.

steps.event: The western mist turns companions into apparent monsters
steps.connection: A later investigation becomes a rescue with distinct contributions and personal costs.

title: From siege and captivity to a negotiated peace
summary: Mobilization, abduction and evidence lead into a peace settlement; the Queen’s later release report retains its attribution.

steps.event: Pristinia deliberates war in the Public Square
steps.connection: Public deliberation produces a united war posture and a call for trackers.

steps.event: Magnus fights Pristinia for the Rahu
steps.connection: The conflict places former companions on opposing sides.

steps.event: The Rahu siege grinds against Pristinia
steps.connection: Continued bombardment makes survival a shared civic burden.

steps.event: Magnus abducts Melian for the Rahu
steps.connection: The abduction removes a civic leader while violence kills witnesses.

steps.event: Pristinia reconstructs Melian’s abduction
steps.connection: The narrator places the investigation on the preceding day; physical clues limit what the town can know.

steps.event: Peace is negotiated and sworn in Rahuvia
steps.connection: Negotiated concessions and an oath change relations between the powers.

steps.event: Ephraith reports Melian’s release after the peace
steps.connection: Ephraith reports release as already completed; no unseen rescue or handover is supplied.

steps.event: The Rahu honor the fallen on both sides
steps.connection: The peace’s aftermath includes a marked place for the dead, while the precise location remains open.

title: Nienna’s return and her later chosen sacrifice
summary: A first death, communal recovery and named restoration precede a different, voluntary sacrifice for Hope.

steps.event: Nienna falls on the Plains of Trial
steps.connection: The quest establishes her first death while Saray survives to bring her home.

steps.event: The Tower community seeks Nienna’s return
steps.connection: A shared effort seeks the means to restore her.

steps.event: Elenia restores Nienna at the Tower
steps.connection: Elenia’s Raise Dead restores her in July; the spell is directly documented.

steps.event: Nienna gives herself so Hope can live
steps.connection: The later September choice is a separate sacrifice for an opportunity to preserve Hope, not another description of the July loss.

title: Grief, judgment and the road toward Babel
summary: Aria’s death leaves grief and contested authority; a rite, duel and compromise lead to a departure directed toward another struggle.

steps.event: Talan kills Aria
steps.connection: The death of Zarathis’s cultural leader becomes the starting point of the aftermath.

steps.event: Bowene receives Aria’s surviving companions
steps.connection: Bowene receives the survivors as an already established High Lord; this is not his accession.

steps.event: Bowene mourns Aria and demands that Talan pay
steps.connection: Grief and demands for punishment remain part of his starting position.

steps.event: Bowene invokes the Crucible of Valor
steps.connection: A formal rite gives the dispute a procedure without proving every accusation true.

steps.event: Elenia defeats Magnus and refuses the duel’s final premise
steps.connection: The confrontation ends in victory and a contested use of power, with consequences beyond the combat.

steps.event: Bowene exiles Elenia without closing the door
steps.connection: The compromise requires Elenia’s departure, permits companions to join, and offers support against the enemy in Babel without granting general return permission.
